title: The image of an open ball under a C¹ map is Borel and has finite H^n measure
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let g : ℝ^n → ℝ^P be a C¹ map, c ∈ ℝ^n and r ∈ ℝ. Then the image g(B_r(c)) of the open ball, which is empty if r ≤ 0, is a Borel subset of ℝ^P, and H^n(g(B_r(c))) < ∞, where H^n = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (c : Euclid n) (r : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → MeasurableSet (g '' ball c r) ∧ μHE[n] (g '' ball c r) ≠ ∞
